OpenKB - Creating your smart knowledge base

OpenKB is an open source tool that transforms documents into a local wiki, connected and maintained by AI, without vector database. Video shows configuration, queries, PageIndex tree structure, watch mode, Obsidian view, AGENTS.md file, and base check command.

A knowledge base without vectors

OpenKB is an open source tool for building a local knowledge base without using vectors 00:00. He takes raw documents and compiles them into a structured, connected and managed AI wiki 00:00.

Initial Settings

For starters, turn openkb init in the terminal, choose the model in LiteLLM format, such as Claude Sonnet from Anthropic, and put the API key in the file .env 00:43.

OpenKB already comes with Gateway LiteLLM, which links providers like OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini 01:05. According to the video, this gives you access to over 100 models, and you can switch models without rewriting code. 01:27.

PageIndex Queries and Structure

For a quick question, use openkb query. For an investigation in multiple rounds, use openkb chat, which keeps the session history 01:48.

The traditional RAG breaks the documents into thousands of pieces of vector and, with each question, tries to rediscover everything from scratch 02:09. OpenKB with PageIndex compiles information in a hierarchical tree, similar to an index, and knowledge accumulates 02:29.

PageIndex documentation summarizes: "Similarity is not relevant" 02:29. In a long PDF, the tool creates index trees with abstracts, and the AI runs through this tree to find the page or section that has the answer 02:50.

Automation with watch mode

Command openkb watch rotates in the background and observes the folder raw 03:10. When you release a PDF, Word or text there, the AI reads the file, generates the abstracts and updates the concepts and crossed links 03:31.

Obsidian View

OpenKB generates Markdown files with double wikilinks 03:31. When opening the Wiki folder in Obsidian, the navigation becomes fluid and the graph shows the connection between the ideas 03:52.

The AGENTS.md file

O AGENTS.md is the AI instruction manual: sets the standard, conventions and how to organize the information 04:13. The AI reads the file every run. If you change a rule, the base organization changes on time without restarting anything 04:34.

The health of the base

With more documents, redundancies and duplications appear 04:34. Command openkb lint scans behind contradictions, orphaned links, information gaps and old content 04:56.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a vector bank?

Nope. OpenKB organizes knowledge in a hierarchical tree without vectors 02:29.

How to keep the base up to date effortlessly?

Leave the openkb watch running: it processes every new file that falls into the folder raw 03:10.

Fonts

  • OpenKB (Open LLM Knowledge Base)OpenKB commands (init, query, chat, watch and lint) and the Markdown wiki generated from the documents.
  • PageIndex (Document Index for Vectorless RAG)The tree structure with abstracts, without vectors, and the phrase "similarity is not relevant".
  • LiteLLM (AI Gateway & Python SDK)LiteLLM connects several AI providers, such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini, with a single interface.

Reviewed by Maurício Yokoyama Issei in 16 November 2026.

About the video

Find out how to build and manage your own permanent digital brain with OpenKB! In this video, we demonstrate step by step to boot and configure your knowledge base locally
. Understand how the system processes long documents using PageIndex tree hierarchical structure, which allows reasoning-based data recovery without the need for vector databases
.
Also learn how to automate the compilation of new files with watch mode
, integrating LiteLLM to use different AI providers (such as Anthropic or Gemini) in a simplified and unified way
, and configuring Obsidian to natively view wikilinks and graph of your knowledge base
. Finally, we explain the fundamental role of the instruction file (AGENTS.md) to maintain the base structure and guide the LLM
, in addition to how to debug and keep concepts always up to date and without redundancy through integrity checks (lint)
.
